caption: The drawing depicts a single andiron (fireplace tool) with a detailed color rendering on the right side and a line drawing on the left. The andiron has a turned vertical post with multiple rounded and flared sections, tapering at the top with a small finial. The lower part of the post connects to three curved legs that end in ball feet, with two legs visible extending outwards and one leg receding back. The colored rendering shows the andiron in shades of metallic gold and bronze, with highlights and shadows suggesting a polished metal surface. Attached behind the base is a horizontal iron bar, rendered in shades of gray to represent metal, indicating the function of supporting firewood. The line drawing on the left shows the same object as a simple black outline without shading, providing a clear structural representation. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing is enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The name "Hans Korsch" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
